cases.translation: Yurka's mood was as bad as could be.
cases.explain: «Настроение» is the grammatical subject of «было» (was), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он казался настолько чуждым для этого ___, что хотелось от него скрыться.
cases.translation: It seemed so alien to this place that he wanted to flee from it.
cases.explain: The preposition «для» (for) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ступая по досочкам-клавишам, Юра направился к ___.
cases.translation: Stepping on the floorboard-keys, Yura headed toward the birch tree.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он прислонил ___ к стене, сел в ветхое зрительское кресло, оно заскрипело.
cases.translation: He leaned the shovel against the wall and sat down in a decrepit theater seat, which creaked.
cases.explain: «Лопату» is the direct object of the transitive verb «прислонил» (leaned), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он был одновременно и ___, и танцполом, где в пасмурные вечера проводились дискотеки.
cases.translation: It was at once a theater and a dance floor, where discos were held on overcast evenings.
cases.explain: A noun functioning as a predicate complement after «был» (was) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: И раньше, когда она звучала здесь каждый день, и сейчас, когда в ___ царила мертвая тишина.
cases.translation: Both before, when it sounded here every day, and now, when dead silence reigned in the movie hall.
cases.explain: «В» expressing static location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Высокое деревянное здание сохранилось на удивление хорошо, только большие окна зияли черными провалами с торчащими осколками в рамах.
reading.question: How well had the tall wooden building survived?
options: Surprisingly well, apart from the broken windows
reading.correct: Surprisingly well, apart from the broken windows
reading.explain: The text says the building survived surprisingly well, only the big windows gaped black with jagged shards in the frames.

reading.ru: Вот бы еще услышать фортепиано, нежную, глубокую, колыбельную, лейтмотив того лета.
reading.question: What did Yura wish he could hear again?
options: The piano, a tender, deep lullaby that was the leitmotif of that summer
reading.correct: The piano, a tender, deep lullaby that was the leitmotif of that summer
reading.explain: Yura wishes he could hear the piano again, a tender, deep lullaby, the leitmotif of that summer.

reading.ru: Тонкая, совсем молодая березка пробилась через фундамент наружу, выломала истлевшие доски и потянулась к свету, к провалу в потолке, через который в темный зал попадали косые бледные лучи.
reading.question: What had grown up through the stage floor where Volodya once sat?
reading.correct: A young birch tree
reading.explain: A thin, very young birch had pushed up through the foundation and reached toward the light coming through a gap in the ceiling.

reading.ru: Володя был один.
reading.question: Who was alone when Yurka peeked into the theater before the first rehearsal?
reading.correct: Volodya
reading.explain: The text states simply, "Volodya was alone."

reading.ru: Сидел слева, на самом краю сцены, читал что-то в тетрадке и грыз грушу.
reading.question: What was Volodya doing when Yurka first saw him at the rehearsal?
options: Sitting at the edge of the stage, reading a notebook and eating a pear
reading.correct: Sitting at the edge of the stage, reading a notebook and eating a pear
reading.explain: He sat at the very edge of the stage, reading something in a notebook and gnawing a pear.

reading.ru: «Маша Сидорова, она у нас на пианино играет, скоро придет.
reading.question: Who gave Volodya the pear, according to what he tells Yurka?
reading.correct: Masha Sidorova
reading.explain: Volodya says Masha Sidorova, who plays the piano, treated him to the pear.

reading.ru: «Смотрю сценарий, думаю, какую тебе дать роль, но, представляешь, нет для тебя здоровенного лба роли».
reading.question: What problem does Volodya say he has with casting Yurka?
options: There is no role big enough for a hulking guy like him
There are too many roles already
reading.correct: There is no role big enough for a hulking guy like him
reading.explain: Volodya says he's looking at the script but there's no role for such a big lug as Yurka.

reading.ru: У лагеря в этом году юбилей.
reading.question: What anniversary does the camp have this year?
reading.correct: Its founding anniversary — thirty years
reading.explain: The text explains it is the camp's thirtieth anniversary since its founding.

reading.ru: «И я бы на твоем месте не забывался, Конев, когда разговариваешь с вожатым».
reading.question: What does Volodya warn Yurka about?
options: Not to forget himself when talking to a counselor
Not to be late for dinner
reading.correct: Not to forget himself when talking to a counselor
reading.explain: Volodya tells Konev not to forget himself when speaking with a counselor.

reading.ru: «А то, что если опять натворишь бед, тебя просто выгонят из лагеря».
reading.question: What consequence does Volodya warn Yurka about if he causes more trouble?
options: He will simply be kicked out of the camp
He will be sent to the infirmary
He will have to apologize publicly
reading.correct: He will simply be kicked out of the camp
reading.explain: Volodya warns that if Yurka causes more trouble he will simply be expelled from camp.

reading.ru: Казалось, что все вокруг сговорились и теперь ищут повод и способы как бы насолить посильнее, как бы забраться поглубже в самые мысли и чувства, как его затравить, задушить.
reading.question: How did Yurka feel everyone around him was treating him?
options: As if they had conspired to torment him as much as possible
As if they all wanted to befriend him
As if they were ignoring him completely
reading.correct: As if they had conspired to torment him as much as possible
reading.explain: Yurka felt everyone had conspired to find ways to hurt him and dig into his thoughts and feelings, to torment and stifle him.

reading.ru: На сцене справа стояла пианино, а в центре бюст вождя пролетариата.
reading.question: What stood in the center of the stage?
options: A bust of the leader of the proletariat (Lenin)
reading.correct: A bust of the leader of the proletariat (Lenin)
reading.explain: The text says a piano stood on the right of the stage, and in the center a bust of the leader of the proletariat.

reading.ru: За прошедший год Маша преобразилась, вытянулась, похудела и отрастила волосы до пояса.
reading.question: How had Masha changed over the past year?
options: She had grown taller, slimmer, and grown her hair to her waist
She had cut her hair short
reading.correct: She had grown taller, slimmer, and grown her hair to her waist
reading.explain: The text describes Masha as transformed: taller, thinner, with hair grown down to her waist.

reading.ru: «Лунная соната!»
reading.question: What piece did Yurka mockingly identify as Masha began to play?
reading.correct: The "Moonlight Sonata"
reading.explain: Yurka winces and names the piece "Lunnaya sonata" (Moonlight Sonata).

reading.ru: Полина, Ульяна и Ксюша.
reading.question: Which three girls burst into the hall together, calling themselves a "trio"?
reading.correct: Polina, Ulyana, and Ksyusha
reading.explain: The text names the trio as Polina, Ulyana, and Ksyusha.

reading.ru: По первым буквам имен Юра называл их «Пук».
reading.question: What nickname did Yura give the trio, based on the first letters of their names?
reading.correct: "Puk"
reading.explain: The text says Yura called them "Puk" using the first letters of their names.

reading.ru: Начался натуральный балаган.
reading.question: What broke out once everyone started shouting over each other about the play?
reading.correct: A genuine circus/commotion
reading.explain: The text describes the chaos as "a genuine circus" (натуральный балаган) beginning.

reading.ru: Вдруг он подвернул ногу, нелепо раскинул руки в стороны и медленно тяжело полетел вниз.
reading.question: What happened to Sanya (the chubby boy) at the edge of the stage?
options: He twisted his foot and fell off the stage
He was pulled back by Volodya just in time
reading.correct: He twisted his foot and fell off the stage
reading.explain: The text says he suddenly twisted his ankle, flung his arms out awkwardly, and fell heavily off the stage.

reading.ru: Отец тысячу раз показывал ему, как проводить осмотр.
reading.question: How did Yurka know how to examine Sanya's injuries?
options: His father, a doctor, had shown him a thousand times
reading.correct: His father, a doctor, had shown him a thousand times
reading.explain: The text explains that Yurka's father had shown him a thousand times how to conduct an examination.

reading.ru: Юрка, пожав плечами, не стал заходить в медпункт.
reading.question: Why didn't Yurka go inside the infirmary with Sanya?
options: He didn't want Volodya to find out about his own embarrassing fall from the apple tree
He was afraid of the nurse
He had to go to dinner
He was too injured to walk
reading.correct: He didn't want Volodya to find out about his own embarrassing fall from the apple tree
reading.explain: Yurka worried the nurse might mention the ointment and Volodya would learn about his shameful tree injury, so he waited outside.

reading.ru: «Только первый день смены, а уже все надоело.
reading.question: What does Volodya complain has already worn him out on just the first day of the shift?
reading.correct: Everything about the counselor's job
reading.explain: Volodya complains that it's only the first day of the shift and he's already sick of everything.

reading.ru: Но это было до того, как вчера проверка нагрянула и выявила кучу замечаний.
reading.question: What happened yesterday that led to more frequent inspections?
options: An inspection arrived and found a bunch of violations
reading.correct: An inspection arrived and found a bunch of violations
reading.explain: The text says an inspection descended yesterday and turned up a pile of complaints.

reading.ru: «Мне пятый отряд завтра на речку везти.
reading.question: What is Volodya anxious about doing tomorrow?
options: Taking the fifth detachment to the river
Giving a speech at the assembly
reading.correct: Taking the fifth detachment to the river
reading.explain: Volodya says he has to take the fifth detachment to the river tomorrow.

reading.ru: У нее девочка в реке утонула.
reading.question: What tragedy does Lena's acquaintance's story involve?
options: A girl drowned in the river
A girl got lost in the forest
reading.correct: A girl drowned in the river
reading.explain: Volodya recounts that Lena's acquaintance was tried in court after a girl drowned in the river.

reading.ru: Божатый вдруг перестал казаться роботом и превратился в обычного человека со своими переживаниями и проблемами, с которыми не всегда знал, как справиться.
reading.question: How did Yurka's perception of Volodya change during their conversation?
options: Volodya stopped seeming like a robot and became an ordinary person with real worries
Volodya seemed even more like a robot
Yurka stopped noticing Volodya at all
reading.correct: Volodya stopped seeming like a robot and became an ordinary person with real worries
reading.explain: The text says the counselor suddenly stopped seeming like a robot and turned into an ordinary person with his own worries and problems.
